profile.headline: Trans in Tech 🏳️‍⚧️
profile.summary: As a Frontend Engineer with over 4 years of hands-on experience, I focus on creating impactful web applications. I thrive in taking projects from concept to completion, prioritizing intuitive, user-friendly designs, and effective collaboration with cross functional teams. I am highly skilled in React, Javascript, CSS, HTML, Node and Google GCP, and I’ve had success in boosting user engagement, streamlining processes, and delivering solutions that truly meet client needs. I’m always eager to learn and tackle new challenges, bringing a practical, problem solving approach to every project I work on.

positions.title: Frontend Developer
positions.description:
• Contribute to the development and maintenance of the Museum’s public-facing digital platforms using modern frontend technologies.

• Build and enhance responsive, accessible user interfaces within a server-rendered application environment.

• Integrate CMS-driven content workflows and support structured, scalable content delivery.

• Collaborate cross functionally with design, content, and backend teams to implement new features and improve existing functionality.

• Troubleshoot complex client/server rendering issues and optimize performance across devices and environments.

• Support deployment workflows, testing practices, and code quality standards to ensure stability and reliability.

• Participate in technical planning discussions and contribute to continuous improvement of frontend architecture and processes.
positions.insights: Skills: Front-End Development · Docker · Nuxt.js · Vue.js · Contentful

positions.title: Frontend Engineer
positions.description:
• Led development of web-based clinical applications, including authentication, scheduling, insurance management, payments, and AI-driven patient intake systems.

• Built and integrated Telehealth features and a provider platform supporting virtual/physical waiting rooms, patient check-ins, and EHR sync (Athena, eCW).

• Developed and maintained internal component libraries and frontend infrastructure (Go servers, Cloud Build, Docker), reducing deployment time by 50%.

• Improved UX by implementing user matching systems, optimizing app flows, and managing a direct support channel.

• Mentored engineers and led small feature teams from planning through release.

• Drove technical modernization efforts, including React 16 → 18 migration and advanced state management patterns (BLoC, WebSockets).

• Partnered closely with leadership and customers, conducting demos, incorporating feedback, and aligning frontend strategy with product goals.

• Maintained comprehensive documentation and QA processes to ensure stability and scalable onboarding.
positions.insights: Skills: JavaScript · React.js · Material-UI · Node.js · Docker · Google Cloud Platform (GCP) · Go (Programming Language) · HTML · Software Infrastructure · Engineering · Front-End Development · RxJS · Firebase

positions.title: Frontend Web Developer (Internship)
positions.description:
• Designed and implemented user-facing features in React, contributing to the development of scalable web applications.

• Styled and optimized interfaces using modern CSS to ensure responsive and accessible design.

• Connected frontend components to Firebase services, including authentication and cloud data storage.

• Improved code maintainability through component-based architecture and modular design patterns.

• Assisted in troubleshooting bugs and refining performance to support a smooth production release cycle.

positions.title: Congressional Travel Escort (Non-Commissioned Officer)
positions.description:
• Selected for a specialized assignment supporting official Congressional and staff delegations.

• Coordinated secure transportation, logistics, and scheduling for domestic and international travel.

• Escorted Members of Congress on overseas visits, ensuring seamless execution of high-level engagements.

• Maintained compliance with diplomatic protocol, security requirements, and interagency coordination standards.

• Collaborated with foreign embassies to obtain international visas and facilitate official travel documentation.

• Processed and managed official passports for Legislative Liaisons and delegation members.

• Served as a liaison between military, governmental, and diplomatic stakeholders to ensure mission success.
positions.insights: Skills: Foreign Affairs · Strategic Planning · Congressional Affairs · Foreign Relations · Federal Government · U.S. Department of Defense

company.name: Pentagon, US Department of Defense, US Army Office of the Chief of Legislative Liaison

positions.title: Freelance Web Developer
positions.description:
• Designed and developed custom websites for small businesses and nonprofit organizations using modern frontend technologies.

• Built and launched a website for a veteran-focused nonprofit organization, improving online presence and community engagement.

• Developed a responsive website for a Los Angeles-based hair salon, enhancing brand presentation and customer booking accessibility.

• Created and configured e-commerce websites, implementing product catalogs, payment processing, and user-friendly checkout flows.

• Collaborated directly with clients to gather requirements, translate business goals into technical solutions, and deliver projects on schedule.

• Ensured responsive design, cross-browser compatibility, and performance optimization across devices.

• Provided ongoing maintenance, updates, and technical support post-launch.

positions.title: Mechanized Infantry Vehicle Commander (Non-Commissioned Officer), U.S. Army
positions.description:
• Led and mentored a team of Soldiers within a mechanized infantry unit, ensuring personnel readiness and team cohesion.

• Commanded and operated armored combat vehicles during training and operational missions.

• Directed tactical maneuvering and real-time decision-making in dynamic, high-pressure environments.

• Maintained accountability and operational readiness of vehicles, weapons systems, and sensitive equipment.

• Oversaw preventive maintenance and coordinated repairs to ensure mission-capable status.

• Enforced safety standards and operational discipline during field exercises and live training events.

• Coordinated with platoon leadership to execute mission objectives and maintain effective communication across units.
positions.insights: Skills: Military Leadership · Problem Solving · Military · Decision-Making · Military Operations · Mentoring

positions.title: Dismounted Reconnaissance Scout, U.S. Army
positions.description:
• Conducted Long-Range Reconnaissance Patrols (LRRP) in austere and high-risk environments to collect actionable intelligence supporting operational planning and command-level decision-making.

• Operated in small, autonomous teams requiring advanced land navigation, surveillance, and mission planning capabilities.

• Maintained operational security and executed missions with minimal supervision under physically and mentally demanding conditions.

• Earned Pathfinder certification; planned and established helicopter landing zones (HLZs) and drop zones (DZs) to support air assault and airborne operations.

• Coordinated air-ground integration to ensure safe insertion, extraction, and movement of personnel and equipment.

• Conducted terrain analysis and provided tactical recommendations to leadership to enhance mission effectiveness.

• Demonstrated adaptability, discipline, and rapid decision-making in dynamic operational environments.
positions.insights: Skills: Time Management · Personal Development · Personnel Management · Team Building · Management · Leadership
